purpose: Operator inspection of a selected vehicle's Redis L2 signal cache, L1/L2 diagnostics, signal category mix and explicitly confirmed cache purges.
primaryGoal: Inspect actual raw cached signal values and diagnose missing telemetry without confusing Redis L2 purges with cluster-wide L1 invalidation.

dataSources.name: Selected vehicle and fleet labels
dataSources.behavior: URL path/query selection precedes persisted store and first vehicle fallback. Selection updates store and vehicle_id URL without discarding unrelated parameters. Fleet data is normalized to an array; the selector hook does not expose loading/error state to this page. Read forwards AbortSignal and uses FAST stale time.
dataSources.scope: Local vehicle selection is required here: /redis-signals explicitly disables the shell vehicle picker in workspaceScope.ts:125. This is not a duplicate workspace selector.

dataSources.name: Raw Redis signals and diagnostic metadata
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['redis-signals', vehicleId]; enabled only for a positive integer; optional 5000 ms polling, off by default; inherits unspecified QueryClient policies. No AbortSignal forwarding. Sorted name/value/type/category rows, name substring search and category filter are derived locally; payload values are not converted. Backend reads Redis L2, optional local L1 snapshot, VIN and newest L2 envelope timestamp. Metadata is supplementary and partially best-effort.
dataSources.contractLimits: Backend omits missing timestamps and VIN, although RedisSignalsMeta declares them required. Newest envelope timestamp is not per-signal freshness and does not prove all fields fresh. Redis decoding/storage units and deployment behavior were not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.name: Other populated vehicle caches
dataSources.behavior: Mounted only while the selected signal view is empty/fatal. Global key ['redis-signal-keys']; staleTime 30000 ms; no AbortSignal. Excludes the active vehicle and empty raw HSETs; shows up to six buttons from up to fifty returned keys. A key-query failure silently removes this subsection. Button selection uses the same selected vehicle owner.

dataSources.name: Per-vehicle purge
dataSources.behavior: requiresLiveMode=true; pins ID/label when dialog opens; explicit danger confirmation; loading disables destructive actions and cancellation. Success/no-op toasts differ; invalidates selected signal and key-list queries. Backend deletes L2 HSET only and does not purge any L1 store.

dataSources.name: Bounded all-vehicle purge
dataSources.behavior: requiresLiveMode=true; exact PURGE ALL typed confirmation; backend bounded to 1000 scanned keys; has_more means more keys likely, not an exact remaining count. Partial/success/error toasts preserve purged/limit values. Invalidates all signal and key-list queries. Both purge routes share five requests per minute per IP. No mutation was executed.

dataSources.name: Coordinate reveal audit
dataSources.behavior: Recognized location values initially masked; reveal audit sends kind and variant, not the raw coordinate. Copy returns underlying value even while masked; default auto-hide is 30 seconds; audit failure is intentionally nonblocking. No reveal/copy action was exercised.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.role: Canonical full-width container and retained-source notice; shell owns navigation.

components.name: LayoutCard
components.role: Existing Card/Heading-backed surface with associated heading; four panels, not a new bento surface owner.

components.name: RedisOperationalBrief / redisMetrics / OperationalBrief
components.role: Existing domain adapter to useOperationalMetrics and shared OperationalBrief; six metrics and L1/L2 timestamp contexts with source/missing-state semantics.
components.inspectionLimit: Shared OperationalBrief and useOperationalMetrics internals were not read; source adapter use is not mounted acceptance.

components.name: DataTable / useSortToggle
components.role: Existing sort, per-column value filters, column layout persistence, density/export toolbar, pagination and virtualized rows. Four columns; category hidden below md. Default CSV/JSON exports serialize matching loaded rows and visible columns, not a new backend export.
components.inspectionLimit: Shared table source inspected in selected ranges only; all toolbar interactions were not exercised.

components.name: RedisDiagnosticEmptyState / DiagnosticBanner / DiagnosticMetaList
components.role: Existing domain owner of missing-cache explanations, docs CTAs, other-vehicle recovery and metadata; uses GlassPanel, Badge, Button, typography and EmptyState.

components.name: MaskedValue
components.role: Current privacy/reveal/copy/timer owner; never replace with bespoke reveal state.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.role: Existing Modal-backed confirmation with exact typed gate, reset-on-open, unsilenceable danger actions and loading dismissal protection.

components.name: Other existing presentation owners
components.role: Reuse existing fields, statuses, definition list, count bars, feedback, freshness and motion; useDateFormat/useNumberFormatting own display locale.
components.inspectionLimit: MetricBar inspected directly; other primitives identified through actual page usage rather than claiming all internals reviewed.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: DiagnosticMetaList/Row recreates the same seven cache fields shown by the page KVList, with unformatted raw counts in the diagnostic copy.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Extract a feature-owned typed metadata-to-KVList adapter accepting meta, t, fmtInt and formatDateTime. Preserve all seven fields and the diagnostic banner's placement; do not hide details merely to deduplicate.

responsive.strategy: Header actions wrap; filters stack below sm; one main column below xl, then two-of-three table span, then three-of-four at 3xl. Side panels stay reachable. Diagnostic metadata changes to two columns at sm. No viewport exercised.

issues.detail: mobileColumns omits category; shared table applies hidden md:table-cell. No mobilePresentation or expandable row is supplied, so per-row category is not reachable in the narrow table even though all categories remain filterable.
issues.fix: Retain category in the mobile table or configure the existing DataTable mobilePresentation with name/value/type/category and full detail reachability. Preserve filter/export/persistence behavior.

issues.detail: Diagnostic icon-plus-copy uses flex-1 without min-w-0 and displays raw Redis keys/VINs in Code. Long key/signal/value behavior at 320px or increased text size is not demonstrated.
issues.fix: Use min-w-0 and existing wrapping/scroll policy for machine identifiers; verify allocated container widths and long values without clipping or deleting metadata.

accessibility.existing: Localized accessible field names; decorative page icons aria-hidden; semantic shared table/fields; associated LayoutCard headings; shared danger confirmation with typed input and loading lock; MetricBar progressbar names and numerical bounds.

issues.detail: Docs CTAs nest a Button inside an anchor, creating invalid nested interactive controls and competing navigation/focus semantics.
issues.fix: Keep one native external anchor with target/rel and compose the existing shared button classes; do not wrap a Button in it.

issues.detail: Other-vehicle recovery chips override the shared Button with h-auto and py-1; no 44px minimum target is supplied. Actual composed size/spacing is unmeasured.
issues.fix: Preserve chip actions but apply the canonical minimum target or document and test a WCAG spacing exception.

accessibility.reducedMotion: MetricBar source uses useMotionPreference and zero-duration/no-initial animation; page FadeIn and refresh-spin behavior not exercised.

states.initialLoading: Six-metric brief loading plus five table skeletons and panel-specific diagnostic/category skeletons; actions remain visible.
states.noSelection: Brief disabled state and three selection empty states; refresh/per-vehicle purge disabled, all-vehicle purge remains available.
states.successfulEmpty: Diagnostic banner distinguishes local mode, L1-present/L2-empty, no recent/never-seen telemetry, and generic empty; missing meta falls back to an empty explanation.
states.filteredEmpty: Search no-match empty state; current search/category controls remain reachable to clear manually.
states.fatalFailure: Typed API/network-specific diagnostic banner plus QueryError retries in the two side panels; brief missing/error state.
states.refreshFailure: deriveDataState retains data; brief shows retained measurements, table/metadata/counts continue rendering, PageLayout supplies DataSourceNotice.
states.staleOffline: DataState understands paused queries; no maxAgeMs is passed. Page brief uses isError rather than complete stale/paused status. Source-envelope age is only displayed as L2 last seen, not a field freshness guarantee.
states.mutation: One pinned target; pending disables purge controls and dialog cancel; distinct success/no-op/partial/error toasts. Failed purge keeps dialog context for retry.

issues.detail: Other-cache query errors silently collapse otherKeys to [] and hide the recovery subsection. The outer banner diagnoses the selected signal source, not necessarily this independent key-list failure.
issues.fix: Expose independent loading/empty/retained/error state and retry for the other-cache source without replacing the main diagnosis or losing prior keys.

issues.detail: Brief retained flag only tracks isError, while deriveDataState also marks paused retained queries stale. Its adapter can label retained/offline cached measurements Source loaded; freshness context is not passed as a timestamp/status.
issues.fix: Extend the existing RedisOperationalBrief adapter to accept the derived trust status/blocked refresh and observed source timestamp; preserve six measurements and PageLayout notice. Keep fetch-success age distinct from newest cached-field age.

issues.detail: Selector hook discards fleet query status; the page can only show no selection/empty options when the fleet lookup initially fails, with no fleet-specific retry.
issues.fix: Extend the existing selector owner to expose optional fleet query/trust state, then distinguish loading, successful no vehicles and failed lookup here; do not add a competing vehicle store or second workspace picker.

visualIssues.detail: All ordinary values receive fixed cyan-300/purple-300/amber-300 text by JavaScript type, creating saturated body content without a theme-aware token. Actual light-theme contrast is unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Use canonical primary/secondary typography for values; retain type labels/badges as the small semantic cue. If syntax colors remain, source them from the existing theme owner and verify real composed contrast.

visualIssues.detail: Independent five-hex palette and default gradient MetricBars give every category a saturated hue; Climate uses danger although category membership is not failure severity.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse current neutral/semantic tokens, choose MetricBar fill=solid and reserve warning/danger for actual unhealthy states. Preserve five named category counts, ordering and proportions.

visualIssues.detail: Two full-width danger buttons permanently emphasize destructive secondary actions alongside ordinary diagnostic content.
visualIssues.fix: Use restrained available secondary/outline entry chrome, with explicit destructive labels and shared danger confirmations unchanged. Keep both actions reachable; do not remove the all-vehicle operation.

architectureIssues.detail: Signal read query ignores TanStack AbortSignal; getRedisSignals cannot receive request options. Diagnostic key query likewise fetches without cancellation.
architectureIssues.fix: Forward {signal} through existing typed devtools helpers for both GET queries, preserving keys, enablement, polling and inherited retry/stale policies; no mutation cancellation change required.

architectureIssues.detail: Presentation component owns useQuery and imports the request helper directly, unlike the page's hook-owned signal and purge data.
architectureIssues.fix: Move the existing key-list query into useRedisSignals.ts with its unchanged key/limit/stale policy and expose typed source state to the diagnostic component.

architectureIssues.detail: Other-cache fallback hardcodes Vehicle ${id}; raw field_count and diagnostic metadata counts bypass locale number formatting.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse redis.vehicleFallback translation and useNumberFormatting counts; do not alter VIN/display-name/source identifiers.

architectureIssues.detail: Required timestamp/VIN declarations do not reflect backend omitempty tags; backend also ignores RawFieldCount errors and supplies default zero L1 counts when the store is absent. Those diagnostics may represent unknown availability, not measured zero.
architectureIssues.fix: Align optional types with actual wire omission. Have the integration owner resolve explicit metadata availability/error indicators before presentation treats best-effort fallback zeros as trusted measurements; never infer a new backend capability in a page rewrite.

architectureIssues.detail: Coordinate masking protects visible cells, not exports: default DataTable export falls back to raw row.value for MaskedValue (no rendered children). CSV and JSON therefore contain raw coordinates. This is a confirmed source behavior, not a demonstrated runtime disclosure or a mandate to remove export.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve existing raw export capability and clarify sensitive loaded-row export scope through existing table controls; validate intentional operator policy and explicit naming before any privacy-policy change. Do not silently redact or delete exports during modernization.

priority.rationale: Preserve working destructive-action safeguards and full raw diagnostics; address invalid nested interaction, mobile category loss and independent-source trust gaps before declaring page acceptance. Noise reduction is presentation work, not permission to change queries or SI values.
order: Nested-link accessibility and full mobile detail reachability
Centralized runtime, keyboard, themes and viewport QA

requiredSharedChanges.name: Redis query/key-list lifecycle integration
props: existing signal/key query keys and enablement
retained data, loading, empty, fatal/refresh error, refetch

requiredSharedChanges.name: Feature-owned Redis diagnostic presentation
props: existing diagnostic error union and meta
usedBy: RedisSignalViewerPage empty table and diagnostics side panel

requiredSharedChanges.name: Fleet selector source trust
props: optional fleet query/trust status and retry
dependsOn: existing selectedVehicle store and URL precedence

competingImplementations.detail: Category color map is a local palette rather than reuse of existing token owners; metadata has both page KVList and feature DiagnosticMetaList renderers.
competingImplementations.fix: Consolidate only the repeated metadata derivation and token choices; keep all current panels and diagnostic contexts. No new ModernCard, generic status registry, table engine, theme or vehicle-selection owner.

sections.name: Cache metrics operational brief
contents: L2 raw fields with last-seen context

auxiliarySurfaces: Single shared conditional danger dialog for two purge modes
Other-cache recovery chips and docs links in diagnostic states
actions: Select vehicle through persisted and URL-backed scope
Manual refresh and side-panel error retries
Search signal names and clear search manually
Select all or one category and clear category filter
Use shared column value filters, column-layout/density/page-size controls and pagination
Export matching loaded visible columns as CSV/JSON, including raw coordinates in current implementation
Reveal/hide/copy recognized coordinates with nonblocking reveal audit and automatic rehide
Choose another populated vehicle cache from diagnostic recovery chips
Open cache configuration/live-state documentation in a new tab
Open/cancel/exact-type PURGE ALL/confirm bounded all-vehicle purge
Retry failed purge and repeat all-purge when has_more
dataBehavior: Preserve every raw source signal identity and number/string/boolean value without display-unit conversion or source recasing.
Preserve categorization precedence and alphabetic initial ordering; category counts derive from all rows, not current search results.
Preserve six metrics, seven diagnostic fields, all five category bars and all specialized diagnostic branches.
Preserve local selection because the shared shell picker is intentionally disabled for this route; this is an undated live snapshot and must not acquire a competing date picker.
Preserve tableId admin:redis-signals, query keys, selected URL/store behavior, polling defaults, loaded-result exports and inherited request policies.
Preserve initial versus retained-data failure behavior; missing measurements stay missing rather than fabricated zero.
Preserve pinned destructive target, exact typed all-purge gate, loading dismissal lock, live-mode request guards, no-op/partial/error distinctions, invalidations and L1/L2 explanations.
Do not imply newest L2 timestamp establishes per-field freshness, or that all-purge guarantees cluster-wide L1 consistency.

evidenceLimits.runtime: unverified; no browser or application route exercised
evidenceLimits.visual: unverified; no screenshots or composed theme review
evidenceLimits.contrast: unverified; source color findings are not measured contrast failures
evidenceLimits.backend: Handler and router source inspected; Redis, L1, HTTP payloads, permissions, deployment reachability and mutations not exercised. Cache implementation and request/QueryClient internals not traced.
evidenceLimits.validation: No Git, TypeScript, full build, lint or test command run, per atomic read-only assignment. Skill audit.sh was read but not executed because it invokes whole-frontend TypeScript. Source-pattern counts are not lint or runtime acceptance.

sourceChecks.scope: Current page only; these zero counts do not erase contextual theme/state/accessibility findings.
